rows.headline: Exclusive-Silver Lake in talks to buy Workday, sources say
rows.prelim_note: M&A / capital structure: private equity firm Silver Lake is in talks for a take-private of Workday at a market value of roughly $43B, which would rank among the largest software buyouts in history; shares surged ~18-26% on the report.

rows.headline: Applied Materials Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
rows.prelim_note: Shifts analyst expectations: record Q3 revenue of $9.12B (+25% YoY) beat the $9.0B estimate and Q4 guidance was raised to $10.25B sales / $4.02 EPS above Street, yet shares fell ~2.7% after-hours on a 'sell the news' reaction.

rows.headline: Maersk delivers strong Q2 and raises full year guidance
rows.prelim_note: Supply/demand + estimate impact: Maersk raised full-year underlying EBITDA guidance to $10.5-12.5B (from $8-10B) on freight rates up 21.6% QoQ to $2,746/FFE, as Strait of Hormuz disruption keeps container capacity rerouted; shares jumped ~8%.
